requirements.title: IEEE_GET_FLAG procedure identity
requirements.source: S17.11.5 p1/p2; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF489.
requirements.definition: IEEE_GET_FLAG is the simple elemental subroutine whose description is get an exception flag.

pending.IEEE_GET_FLAG-get-exception-flag-descrip: Source-use plan imports IEEE_EXCEPTIONS or IEEE_ARITHMETIC and calls IEEE_GET_FLAG with IEEE_OVERFLOW and a logical variable initialized to the opposite sentinel.
pending.IEEE_GET_FLAG-simple-elemental-subroutin: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG for IEEE_OVERFLOW and IEEE_INEXACT before IEEE_SET_FLAG setup and IEEE_GET_FLAG observation. Supported branch calls IEEE_GET_FLAG for a scalar flag and a rank-one array of those two flags with a conforming logical array, then asserts elementwise logical results after explicit setup; unsupported branch records skip.

requirements.oracle: Source registration only for IEEE_GET_FLAG. Future fixtures use guarded branch plans for IEEE processor support: probe the relevant IEEE_SUPPORT_* inquiry first, assert the stated effect only in the supported branch, and record an unsupported branch as skip rather than pass. requirements.title: IEEE_GET_FLAG argument contract and flag value result
requirements.source: S17.11.5 p3; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF489.
requirements.definition: FLAG shall be IEEE_FLAG_TYPE and specifies the exception flag; FLAG_VALUE shall be logical INTENT(OUT) and receives true for a signaling IEEE_INVALID, IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, or IEEE_INEXACT flag and false otherwise.

pending.IEEE_GET_FLAG-FLAG-type: Positive source control calls IEEE_GET_FLAG with IEEE_OVERFLOW and IEEE_INEXACT constants; source-control mutation uses an IEEE_ROUND_TYPE constant and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.IEEE_GET_FLAG-FLAG_VALUE-logical-intent-: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW) before IEEE_SET_FLAG and IEEE_GET_FLAG calls. Supported branch initializes FLAG_VALUE to .true., sets IEEE_OVERFLOW quiet, calls IEEE_GET_FLAG, asserts FLAG_VALUE becomes .false.; companion initializes .false., sets signaling, and asserts .true.; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.IEEE_GET_FLAG-returns-signaling-state: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW). Supported branch uses IEEE_SET_FLAG to set IEEE_OVERFLOW quiet then signaling, calls IEEE_GET_FLAG after each setup, and asserts .false. then .true.; unsupported branch records skip.
